SELECT 'closures' k, store_id::VARCHAR a, closure_type b, closure_start_date::VARCHAR c, closure_end_date::VARCHAR e, weeks_closed::VARCHAR f FROM ref_store_closure
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dupes', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no))::VARCHAR, MIN(sale_date)::VARCHAR, MAX(sale_date)::VARCHAR FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'retdupes', COUNT(*)::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id)::VARCHAR, '', MIN(return_date)::VARCHAR, MAX(return_date)::VARCHAR FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-28' AND DATE '2025-08-24' OR return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_weeks AS (
    SELECT st.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
           (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= d.fiscal_week_start_date)
           AND (st.close_date IS NULL OR st.close_date >= d.fiscal_week_end_date)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c WHERE c.store_id = st.store_id
                 AND c.closure_start_date <= d.fiscal_week_end_date AND c.closure_end_date >= d.fiscal_week_start_date) AS trading
    FROM dim_store st
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, fiscal_week_start_date, fiscal_week_end_date FROM dim_date
                WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17) d
    WHERE st.is_current AND st.store_id < 900
),
lfl_store_weeks AS (
    SELECT ty.store_id, ty.fiscal_week
    FROM store_weeks ty
    JOIN store_weeks ly ON ly.store_id = ty.store_id AND ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
    JOIN dim_store st ON st.store_id = ty.store_id AND st.is_current
    WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ty.trading AND ly.trading
      AND (st.open_date IS NULL OR st.open_date <= DATE '2026-08-03' - 364)
),
lfl_sales AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.store_id) stores
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN lfl_store_weeks l ON l.store_id = n.store_id AND l.fiscal_week = d.fiscal_week
    WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 14 AND 17
      AND d.fiscal_period = 4
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ty.net_sales AS this_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year, ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 2) AS lfl_growth_pct, ty.stores, ly.stores, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lfl_store_weeks) sw
FROM lfl_sales ty, lfl_sales ly WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) ns FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND n.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2),
ctl AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, r.store_id, SUM(r.net_sales) cs FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<900 GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT COALESCE(m.store_id,c.store_id) store_id, COALESCE(m.fiscal_year,c.fiscal_year) fy, m.ns, c.cs, ROUND(m.ns-c.cs,2) diff
FROM mine m FULL JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id=m.store_id AND c.fiscal_year=m.fiscal_year
ORDER BY ABS(COALESCE(m.ns,0)-COALESCE(c.cs,0)) DESC, 1,2 LIMIT 15

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, COUNT(DISTINCT f.store_key) store_keys, COUNT(*) lines, SUM(f.net_amount) net, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 12 AND 19 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH sw AS (
 SELECT s.store_id, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(f.net_amount) ns, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sale_date) days
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
 WHERE s.store_id<900 AND d.fiscal_period=4 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL)
SELECT 'minmax' k, fiscal_year, COUNT(*)::VARCHAR n, MIN(ns)::VARCHAR mn, MIN(days)::VARCHAR d, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id)::VARCHAR st FROM sw GROUP BY fiscal_year
UNION ALL
SELECT 'weak', fiscal_year, store_id::VARCHAR, fiscal_week::VARCHAR, ns::VARCHAR, days::VARCHAR FROM sw WHERE days<7 OR ns < 3000
UNION ALL
SELECT 'stores', is_current::VARCHAR, COUNT(DISTINCT store_id)::VARCHAR, '', '', '' FROM dim_store WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY is_current
